entities.name: Early Republic and Instability

entities.summary: The early Dominican Republic faced constant Haitian invasion attempts, internal power struggles between the 'Red' (liberal) and 'Blue' (conservative) factions, and the extraordinary annexation of the country back to Spain (1861–1865), which was reversed by the War of Restoration.
